If you didn't receive the invite, reply with a preferred time and timezone and I'll resend with the calendar set to your locale. Attaching the invite and a 1-page agenda.

Agenda (15–30 min):
- Quick recap of Redwood architecture and serving modes (5 min)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the follow-up. I didn't get the calendar invite on my side (checked spam/other calendars) — we're based out of London so GMT times are easiest for us.

Monday 19:00 GMT is doable but a bit late for some of our engineers. Can we aim for Tue, Dec 7 at 17:00 GMT instead (that maps to your 09:00 PT)? That would be best. Also can you include Jordan Li (jordan.li@edgeanalytics.com) — he'll own the infra side.

Also, FYI, sometimes our calendar system mis-parses invites with PT as the organizer timezone, so if you can create the invite with Europe/London as the event timezone or send the .ics explicitly set to GMT, that usually solves it.

- Alex
